description:
Bhumyaakash is a team of passionate young innovators driven by curiosity, scientific exploration, and a vision to create meaningful solutions. Representing the connection between Earth and Sky, we aim to combine science, technology, creativity, and teamwork to address real-world challenges. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aspire to explore, innovate, learn, and contribute ideas towards a better and more sustainable future.

Bhumyaakash – Exploring Earth, Reaching Beyond.
summary:
Namaste and Hello,
we are team Bhumyaakash
We are a bunch of Space and technical Enthusiasts who have a developed a State-of-Art website were we forelook to represent the NISAR data in the common language for anyone from high school students to Disaster Response Teams.
We have solved major issues by using complex filters like the Gamma-MAP for the Speckle filtration and have solved major other problems which we have clearly represented in the website
details: "Dancing with the SARs" (Project Bhumyakash) is a NASA Space Apps Challenge web dashboard built with Leaflet.js, Bolt, and ESA SNAP that visualizes NISAR Level-2 GCOV/GSLC radar observation data across Bharat, leveraging adaptive Gamma-MAP speckle filtering to suppress multiplicative noise and preserve sharp linear boundaries for reliable all-weather, day-and-night temporal backscatter analysis.
